title: When the Inheritance Sings
author: Ada Blackwood
blurb: Ivo Brightwater, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
